results.title: Implementation of Additional Sanctions Against Russia: Additions to the Entity List
results.abstract: The Bureau of Industry and Security adds one entity to the Entity List under the destination of Kazakhstan for acting contrary to the national security or foreign policy interests of the United States.

results.title: Expansion of End-User Controls for Affiliates of Certain Listed Entities: Request for Comment on Scope and Implementation
results.abstract: The Bureau of Industry and Security seeks public comment on the scope of the 50 percent affiliates rule scheduled to take effect on November 10, 2026, including whether the aggregation standard should be modified and whether additional transition relief is warranted.
